onboard.frontierhunts.asg.card.done_body: Well done, ranger. Field work, bounties and supply runs on the Assignments board pay tokens and Ranger XP.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.field.active: Taken: %s. Open Ranger Assignments to see how far along it is.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.field.failed: Failed: %s. Open Ranger Assignments to try again or drop it.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.field.none: No field assignment taken yet. The Assignments board offers field patrols, blood trails, trophy surveys and supply runs for tokens and Ranger XP.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.field.ready: Done: %s. Open Ranger Assignments and collect the reward.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.footer: Press %s any time to open Ranger Assignments.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.p1: Ranger Assignments are your training and your work. The Ranger Academy has six courses, each on its own private range: the gear is lent and you get all your own things back when you leave. Every course you pass also ticks lessons in this book. Take them in order, one at a time.
onboard.frontierhunts.asg.title: Ranger Assignments
seat.frontierhunts.lowered: Seat lowered: eye level with the windows of the small tower blind
seat.frontierhunts.raised: Seat raised: eye level with the windows of the big tower blind
seat.frontierhunts.tip.blind_chair: Swivels with you. Seated, your eyes are level with a ground blind's windows.
seat.frontierhunts.tip.camp_chair: Folding canvas chair for camp and the fire.
seat.frontierhunts.tip.log_stump_seat: A sawn stump with a hide pad. Turn any way you like.
seat.frontierhunts.tip.sit: Right-click to sit · Sneak to stand up
seat.frontierhunts.tip.tower_chair: Swivels with you and fits itself to tower blinds: eye level with the windows. Sneak + use to raise or lower it.
seat.frontierhunts.tip.trail_bench: Benches placed side by side join into one long bench.
